latency_aggregation: geometric mean of three per-run median latencies
split_protocol: repository original split plus deterministic unique random 10/6 splits; both sides must contain FP16 and BF16, head dimensions 64 and 128, causal and non-causal workloads, and at least two query-head counts
random_search_note: Random search is omitted because it does not train on the development partition; the earlier 100-seed held-out comparison remains its direct baseline.
